brakeFluid.value: Nissan heavy-duty brake fluid or DOT 3

coolant.value: Nissan Long Life Coolant/Antifreeze, pre-diluted; 9-1/2 US qt (9.0 L) with reservoir

engineOil.value: SAE 5W-30, API certified (Nissan Ester Oil recommended)

oilCapacity.value: 5-1/8 US qt (4.9 L) with filter; 4-7/8 US qt (4.6 L) without

tirePressure.value: See the driver's door jamb placard

transFluid.value: Nissan Matic S ATF (AWD transfer case: Nissan Matic J ATF)

specs.name: Wheel lug nuts
specs.notes: Owner's manual: 108 N·m (80 ft-lb). Tighten in the order shown in the manual with the car lowered. No oil or grease on studs or nuts. Re-torque after the first 1,000 km (600 mi).

specs.name: Front caliper mounting (torque member) bolts
specs.notes: From the 2014 QX50 factory service manual, BR-37. 2-piston sliding caliper.

specs.fastener: 2 bolts, cylinder body to torque member
specs.name: Front caliper body (sliding pin) bolts
specs.notes: From the 2014 QX50 factory service manual, BR-35. Grease the sliding pins with rubber grease, not the bolt threads.

specs.name: Rear caliper mounting bolts
specs.notes: From the 2014 QX50 factory service manual, BR-43.

specs.name: Rear caliper sliding pin bolts
specs.notes: From the 2014 QX50 factory service manual, BR-41 and BR-43. Grease the pin shank.

specs.name: Front bleeder valve
specs.notes: From the 2014 QX50 factory service manual, BR-37. 69 in-lb. Snug only.

specs.name: Rear bleeder valve
specs.notes: From the 2014 QX50 factory service manual, BR-43. 73 in-lb. Snug only.

specs.name: Brake hose union (banjo) bolts, front and rear
specs.notes: From the 2014 QX50 factory service manual, BR-20 and BR-23. Use new copper washers every time.

specs.name: Brake tube flare nuts
specs.notes: From the 2014 QX50 factory service manual, BR-20 and BR-23. Don't scratch the flare nut or the tube.

specs.name: Wheel hub lock nut (drive shaft nut)
specs.notes: No confident value. Front nut only on AWD; rear on all. Single-use staked nut, replace it.

specs.name: Outer tie rod end nut
specs.notes: No confident value. Check the ST section of the service manual.

specs.name: Oil pan drain plug
specs.notes: Owner's manual range 29–39 N·m (22–29 ft-lb); 34 N·m is mid-range. Always use a new washer. Don't overtighten.

specs.name: Spin-on oil filter
specs.notes: Owner's manual: turn until you feel light resistance, then 2/3 turn more. Torque range 14.7–20.5 N·m (11–15 ft-lb). Oil the new gasket first.

specs.name: Spark plugs
specs.notes: Plug type FXE24HR-11, gap 1.1 mm (owner's manual 9-9). Torque is in the EM section, not the owner's manual. Cold engine only; the rear bank needs the intake plenum removed.

specs.name: Ignition coil bolts
specs.notes: No confident value. Low torque into plastic; snug only.

specs.name: Transmission drain plug (RE7R01A)
specs.notes: No confident value. Refill and level check need fluid temperature 35–45 °C through the check plug. Use the manual or a shop.

specs.name: Rear differential drain / filler plugs
specs.notes: Plug torque not in the owner's manual; check the DLN section. Oil: Nissan Super GL-5 80W-90 hypoid, or API GL-5 SAE 80W-90 (owner's manual 9-2).

note: Verified from the 2014 QX50 factory service manual (BR) and owner's manual (OM).
